in_marathi.name: Kanisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kanisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kan' meaning 'Goddess' and 'Isha' meaning 'Goddess of Knowledge'. This name is associated with Saraswati, the Hindu goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning.
